:::: content
Like [Naradmuni](http://avizit.blogspot.com/2005/04/latex-row-height-in-tabular.html), I'm always forgetting the simple command to make the rows of a LaTeX table bigger.

::: geshifilter
``` {.text .geshifilter-text style="font-family:monospace;"}
\renewcommand\arraystretch{MyValue}% (MyValue=1.0 is for standard spacing)
```
:::
::::
